correctness.rationale: Reconstructed intrinsic right-translation fibers of Q_n via centerlessness of S_n; a quandle automorphism acts on S_n labels by an inner group automorphism from its action on identity fiber. Its remaining fiber permutation a_g centralizes g and is conjugacy-equivariant, hence a_{g_lambda}∈Z(C_G(g_lambda)); conversely each such family gives a homomorphism. Diagonal S_n splitting yields product, and δ=(g_lambda)_lambda gives inner subgroup. Independently enumerated partition products K_3=6, K_4=96, K_5=2880, hence full orders 36,2304,345600 and outer indices 1,8,48. Tested centralizer cycle-factor formula rather than relying solely on attached finite script.
